static_traits.name: Zhang Bowen
static_traits.family_status: Living alone; parents supportive but financially unstable
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends, but avoiding talking about tuition and college with friends for fear of being judged or pitied; feeling intense pressure and comparison when seeing peers prepare for college
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy in the past; no similar psychological problems appeared before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good cooperativeness; tending to use negative, emotional expressions (e.g. 'despair', 'failure'); speech rate not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling overwhelmed and despair because I cannot afford college tuition this year, accompanied by self-inadequacy and fear of not being able to pursue higher education; the problem persists and triggers high anxiety about future opportunities.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of low self-esteem and despair are significantly affecting my mental health and motivation to achieve goals; I hope counseling can relieve the impact and rebuild motivation.
growth_experiences: Long-term financially unstable family environment: parents supportive in attitude but limited financially; I am currently living alone.
Since adolescence has dreamed of receiving higher education, 'going to university' is regarded as an important life goal and value direction.

core_beliefs: I have no ability to change my situation

special_situations.event: Receiving the college admission notice and learning of the high tuition, finding I cannot afford it this year
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot enroll this year, I may never get to attend college, losing future opportunities
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Desperately searching for scholarship and financial aid information, considering a second job to make up for financial inadequacy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never be able to afford tuition

special_situations.event: Sees same-age friends posting updates about preparing for university on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot enroll at the same time as my peers, it shows I am inferior to them and am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing tuition and college topics with friends, reduced social contact to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am inferior to them; everyone is moving forward while I lag behind

special_situations.event: Attention occupied by anxiety about tuition and enrollment during hotel night-shift work, finding it hard to focus
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If work performance is affected, it proves I lack ability and will not get a better job in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Considering overtime or a second job to 'prove myself', while constantly worrying about the future
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot even do this well; I will never have a better job in the future

special_situations.event: Alone contemplating the reality of not being able to enroll this year
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must start university this year, otherwise it equals complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent self-blame and anxiety, dismissing existing positive clues (e.g. partial scholarship possibilities)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I cannot get in this year, it equals total failure

core_conflict.wish: Longing to gain ability, recognition, and a better future through higher education
core_conflict.fear: Fears being seen as a failure, fears falling behind forever, fears losing life opportunities due to financial limits
defense_goal: Avoids talking with friends about further education and finances to reduce shame and judged feelings
Dismissing possibilities with reasons like 'this is just wishful thinking, the cost is too high' to lower anxiety and maintain self-esteem

object_relations.object_representation: Peers / others are a successful and judgmental group

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor encourages exploring feasible options (such as scholarships, booking a financial advisor) or proposes a concrete action plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously considering these suggestions unrealistic, fearing being forced to face my own 'incompetence' and sense of failure (transference: seeing others as potential judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using negative, dismissive wording (e.g. 'unrealistic', 'just wishful thinking'), in a low tone, reducing details and concrete commitments; when necessary shifting the topic back to the fact of 'too high' tuition to avoid in-depth discussion.

manifestations: Believes the dream is slipping away, feeling 'everyone else is moving forward while I fall behind'
Not being able to enroll as planned seen as life's path losing meaning
outcomes: Decreased drive and impaired work performance

manifestations: Financial constraints making it impossible to choose enrollment timing and path as wished
Feeling bound by tuition and real-world constraints
Avoiding discussing my anxiety and financial difficulties with friends
outcomes: Social support not yet effectively utilized
Increased sense of loneliness, anxiety maintained

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes 'should go to university this year' as an absolute standard
Blames himself with 'everyone is moving forward while I fall behind'

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Avoiding sharing anxiety and financial pressure with friends
Bearing pressure alone rather than actively seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When invited to explore feasible plans, avoiding concrete details and implementation with general statements like 'the cost is too high' and 'unrealistic'

exception_events.target_problem: When facing high tuition and enrollment pressure, the client usually falls into catastrophic and despairing thinking, avoiding discussing with others or taking concrete action.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During one action of searching for scholarships and financial aid, the client did not completely fall into despair as usual, but found several scholarships she might qualify for, and felt a glimmer of hope.
exception_events.reason: Clue: took a different approach (proactively searching for information and resources), and noticed partial funding possibilities, thus experiencing something different from before (a sense of hope).

positive_force: Has savings experience, with some ability for self-management and resource-seeking
Can proactively look for scholarship and financial aid information
Has long-term stable motivation and value commitment toward going to university
negative_force: Catastrophizing and future-predicting thinking tendency (believing I can never afford it)
Excessive comparison and Self-denial (seeing myself as a 'laggard')
Avoiding socializing and seeking help (fearing being judged or pitied)
Unstable family finances and limited current income (night-shift work)
Sleep and appetite are impaired, lowering drive and stress resistance

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent catastrophic worry and Self-denial around 'cannot afford tuition' (accompanied by anxiety, physical effects)
antecedent: Received the admission letter and learned of the high tuition
Seeing peers on social media preparing to go to university
Alone contemplating not being able to enroll this year
target_behavior.core_reason: In a financially unstable family environment and under internalized value conditions, binding enrollment timing to personal worth in black-and-white terms, generating catastrophic and overgeneralizing cognitions.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and shame, gaining short-term 'sense of explanation / control', while finding reasons for inaction.
target_behavior.consequence: Worsened anxiety, disturbed sleep and appetite, decline in work performance, problem-solving delayed.

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids discussing tuition and further-education topics with friends
antecedent: Sees peers' university-related updates on social media
target_behavior.core_reason: Worried about being judged or pitied, with strong inner shame, tending to protect self-esteem through avoidance.
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential negative evaluation and shame experiences, maintaining a fragile sense of self-worth.
target_behavior.consequence: Social support and information channels not yet utilized, increased sense of loneliness, real problems not yet alleviated.
